advantages.title: Why people trust us
items: Qualified teachers experienced with international learners
Focus on speaking practice and overcoming the language barrier
Medical and academic terminology built into programmes
Flexible formats: in person in Prague or online

items.question: Which level can I start from?
items.answer: We offer zero-beginner programmes and modules for those who already speak Czech. We will choose the right format in a consultation.

items.question: Is learning in person or online?
items.answer: Both formats are available: classes in Prague and online groups. They can be combined by arrangement.

items.question: When do new groups start?
items.answer: Intakes happen several times a year. Leave a request and a coordinator will share the next dates.

items.quote: Approval felt impossible. The team helped with documents and language — I now work in a clinic.
